quest.title: Festival Afterword
quest.description: After the performance, you find Mamoru, who appears quite flustered indeed. Has he encountered some trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Bad news!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Boss got arrested again!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Just now, someone from the Tenryou Commission came to post a notice on the bulletin board saying our festival has to be suspended.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: I don't know what happened. I think maybe the boss sent some flyers to Tenshukaku.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: He did say that the Shogun would definitely not wanna miss the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, I think Boss is right. The Almighty Shogun would definitely wanna come to the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Yeah... don't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Come on, who cares what we think?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Anyway, the boss was arrested on the spot by the Okuzumeshuu. They took him to the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you going to do?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Shinobu's probably on the case by now.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: I heard the Okuzumeshuu charged the boss with causing a disturbance in a restricted military zone.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Then Madam Kujou Sara changed it to obstructing the public order.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Ahhhhh, that despicable Kujou Tengu! How can she get away with charging Boss with a felony over something like this!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: You idiot! That's a misdemeanor, she downgraded the offense. Usually, you just get a warning for that...

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Anyway, I guess we'll just have to wait until the boss gets out before seeing what to do about the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Traveler. With Shinobu on the case, everything's gonna turn out just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: You've been so supportive of our festival. When the boss gets out, I'm sure he'll want to thank you in person!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: I hope your journey, like our festival, will go from strength to strength.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Gang Members
dialogues.text: From strength to strength!
